verdict.rationale: A state business-filing and registration system could plausibly offer autonomous or background automations, such as scheduled filings or automated status monitoring, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the SCC and CIS hosts disallow all crawling. Those probes say nothing about any automation capability, so nothing supports the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
